overview: Harden and complete the multi-profile system for Rainbow AI. Three properties (Pelangi Capsule Hostel, Southern Homestay, Makan Moments Cafe) each need independent configs, KB, admin dashboard, and WhatsApp routing. The ProfileRegistry, per-profile ConfigStore, KnowledgeBaseInstance, and profile switcher UI are implemented. Now: make all admin routes profile-aware, add tests, update deploy script, and ensure dashboard tabs reload correctly on profile switch.
goals: All admin API routes return profile-specific data when x-profile-id header is sent
Dashboard profile switcher reloads all tab data on switch
Unit tests cover multi-profile config resolution and pipeline routing
deploy.sh includes all 3 KB directories and profile data directories
Intent manager, templates, knowledge-base, and testing routes are profile-aware

userStories.description: Currently only config.ts uses getStore(res) for profile-aware config. userStories.title: Dashboard profile switcher triggers full data reload
userStories.description: When the user switches profiles in the dashboard dropdown, all cached data must be cleared and the active tab must reload with the new profile's data. Currently profile-switcher.js calls reloadCurrentTab() but there is no such function. Need to: (1) clear window.cacheManager on switch, (2) reset cached global vars (cachedRouting, cachedSettings, etc.), (3) call loadTab() for the active tab to refetch all data, (4) update the page title or subtitle to show the active property name.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching profiles clears cacheManager cache
Switching profiles resets cachedRouting, cachedKnowledge, cachedWorkflows, cachedSettings, cachedIntentNames globals
Active tab reloads with new profile's data after switch
Dashboard tab shows correct property name after switch
No stale data from previous profile visible after switch
technicalNotes: profile-switcher.js is at src/public/js/core/profile-switcher.js
Global state vars are in src/public/js/core/state.js: cachedRouting, cachedKnowledge, cachedWorkflows, cachedSettings, cachedIntentNames
cacheManager is at window.cacheManager with a .clear() method (check cache-manager.js)
Tab loading: window.loadTab(tabName) is in src/public/js/core/tabs.js
Active tab detection: document.querySelector('.sidebar-item.active') or similar
The loadTab function already refetches data from API, so clearing cache + calling loadTab is sufficient
